limits: Production handlers/templates run with launchScope:true against four ephemeral synthetic identities.
Real existing catalogue prices/variants/photos come from the bundled readback snapshot; no live customer, merchant or checkout writes.
Signed purchase/delivery events and Shopify identity remain isolated simulations, not payment acceptance.
Chrome content viewport 393×852pt at3×, no Safari/status-bar chrome; actual JPEG export is handled by the review pack.
Only explicitly whitelisted existing product photo GETs are allowed outside loopback; every Shopify cart navigation is intercepted.

liveReadOnlyService.method: Read-only public HTTP GETs and SSH file SHA-256/runtime-boolean reads. No database queries, customer tokens, writes, webhook events or Shopify mutations.

nonRuntimeFiles.reason: Editor helper module is not imported by server runtime or included by Dockerfile COPY.
Deployment configuration, not copied into the runtime image.

Dockerfile.limitation: Dockerfile content hash is local evidence; the deployed image does not contain Dockerfile. Matching build log COPY/base instructions and all copied runtime hashes verify its effective inputs; remote Dockerfile byte identity cannot be proven.

limits: No authenticated production recipient record was accessed. Live checks prove unauthenticated rejection and launch routing, not the entire real recipient lifecycle.

Recipient secrecy, exact ownership, delivery/unwrap, refund/replay and stale buyer recheck were tested separately against isolated production handlers: 483 service/editor cases and 16 launch browser assertions; those do not prove real OAuth/payment/APNs/carrier delivery.
Installed Shopify read_fulfillments and fulfillment_events/create were verified separately in delivery-integration-verification.json. No live carrier event or physical push was manufactured.
No real device, Safari Universal Link, TestFlight or APNs acceptance is claimed.

deliveryIntegration.evidence: Installed scopes and API subscription read back after user approval. No production purchase or delivery was simulated.

limits: Actual simulator sizes: primary iPhone18Pro402×874pt and smaller iPhone17e390×844pt. Gallery393×852pt is separate controlled content evidence.
Offline cases use DEBUG transport fixtures. Optimized Release root does not prove simulated offline behavior.
Largest shipping root assertions run on both devices; registration-largest accessibility is a separate optional stage.
No current unsuppressed accessibility pass is inferred from Build41 historical accepted findings.

Real Shopify OAuth/payment/tax/shipping, physical universal links/Safari, physical APNs/background/terminated, VoiceOver, older OS17 compatibility and production restoration remain independent acceptance.

Gift secrecy is enforced on authenticated recipient app data. Public buyer pages show GIFTED; an owner visiting anonymously cannot be distinguished from a buyer. Strong secrecy outside the app requires a separate buyer-authentication policy.
